component.name: Git Profiles
component.summary: Organize your git repositories by SSH profile

description.p: Git Profiles manages your SSH/Git identities straight from ~/.ssh/config. Each Host block is a profile you can create and edit from a Kirigami interface.

ul.li: Create and edit SSH profiles (Host, HostName, User, Port, IdentityFile).
Attach a profile to directories and rewrite the git remotes of the repositories there, with a dry-run preview.
Configure the provider CLI (gh / gt / glab) per directory via direnv, keeping tokens in the system keyring.
Test an SSH connection for a profile.

screenshot.caption: Browsing SSH profiles grouped by provider
